plain_english: Now the glad-hearted should go to the worship-place; for wherever the heart is gladdened and made fit for absorption into the Lord, there it becomes — that alone is the mark, nothing else; for even in the saying, meditated identity alone is the cause, and that too is from being-glad alone — nothing else is the place.
sanskrit_cite: atha prasannahṛdayo yāgasthānaṃ yāyāt tac ca yatraiva hṛdayaṃ prasādayuktaṃ parameśvarasamāveśayogyaṃ bhavati tad eva na tu asya anyal lakṣaṇam uktāv api dhyeyatādātmyam eva kāraṇam tad api bhāvaprasādād eva iti nānyat sthānam

plain_english: But seat, mountain-top and the rest in scripture is to be understood as aimed at pointing out this place.
sanskrit_cite: pīṭhaparvatāgram ityādis tu śāstre sthānoddeśa etatpara eva boddhavyaḥ

plain_english: In these seats and the rest, by the Lord's ordainment, powers entered by the Lord take body — like noble lands for the pious, like barbarian lands for the impious; the teaching of the mountain-top, through solitude, from distraction-avoidance, is the state of one-pointedness — thus.
sanskrit_cite: teṣu teṣu pīṭhādisthāneṣu parameśaniyatyā parameśvarāviṣṭānāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehagrahaṇāt āryadeśā iva dhārmikāṇāṃ mlecchadeśā iva adhārmikāṇām parvatāgrādeś caikāntatvena vikṣepaparihārāt aikāgryapadatvam iti

plain_english: There, before the worship-house, outside alone, one should do the general placing — first on the hands, then on the body.
sanskrit_cite: tatra yāgagṛhāgre bahir eva sāmānyanyāsaṃ kuryāt karayoḥ pūrvaṃ tato dehe

plain_english: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ, hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ — thus; by these two, expressing power and the power-bearer, the two Mālinī-alphabet mantras; with each one singly — first power, then the power-bearer — in release from foot-tip to head-end; in enjoyment everything is reversed.
sanskrit_cite: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ ity ābhyāṃ śaktiśaktimadvācakābhyāṃ mālinīśabdarāśimantrābhyām ekenaiva ādau śaktiḥ tataḥ śaktimān iti muktau pādāgrāc chiro'ntam bhuktau tu sarvo viparyayaḥ

plain_english: For Mālinī the Goddess is the chief Śākta form, milking all wishes through the collision of seed and womb.
sanskrit_cite: mālinī hi bhagavatī mukhyam śāktaṃ rūpaṃ bījayonisaṃghaṭṭena samastakāmadugham

plain_english: And meaningful is this name: garlanded with Rudra-power garlands, flowered in fruits, the bee of the sound that dissolves the winter of transmigration, holding attainment and release, endowed with the power to give and to withhold — since ra and la are remembered as one.
sanskrit_cite: anvarthaṃ caitan nāma rudraśaktimālābhir yuktā phaleṣu puṣpitā saṃsāraśiśirasaṃhāranādabhramarī siddhimokṣadhāriṇī dānādānaśaktiyuktā iti ralayor ekatvasmṛteḥ

plain_english: Hence very, for even a broken-rite mantra becomes complete through this placing; even a stained one — Gāruḍa, Vaiṣṇava and the rest — having reached stainlessness, becomes release-giving.
sanskrit_cite: ata eva hi bhraṣṭavidhir api mantra etannyāsāt pūrṇo bhavati sāñjano 'pi gāruḍavaiṣṇavādir nirañjanatām etya mokṣaprado bhavati

plain_english: After the body-placing, this same placing is to be done on the vessel.
sanskrit_cite: dehanyāsānantaram arghapātre ayam eva nyāsaḥ

plain_english: For here, for firmness of realization of non-difference with the Lord, the worship-act is made the example: there, of all factors, thus is Lord-ness — there, from the sacrificer's place-purity-bringing-doings, from vessel-purity, from placing, from the sacrificer's body-placing, from the worshippable's altar-placing.
sanskrit_cite: iha hi kriyākārakāṇāṃ parameśvarābhedapratipattidārḍhyasiddhaye pūjākriyā udāharaṇīkṛtā tatra ca sarvakārakāṇām itthaṃ parameśvarībhāvaḥ tatra yaṣṭrādhārasya sthānaśuddhyāpādānakaraṇayor arghapātraśuddhinyāsābhyām yaṣṭur dehanyāsāt yājyasya sthaṇḍilādinyāsāt

plain_english: Thus, even by rite-order alone, making all factors the Lord's, seeing all rites with just this view, without chief knowledge and yoga — one becomes the Supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kriyākrameṇāpi parameśvarīkṛtasamastakārakaḥ tayaiva dṛśā sarvakriyāḥ paśyan vināpi pramukhajñānayogābhyāṃ parameśvara eva bhavati

plain_english: Thus, having placed on the vessel, having worshipped with flowers, smoke and the rest, one should sprinkle the rite-essence and the flowers and the rest with its drops.
sanskrit_cite: evam arghapātre nyasya puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tadvipruḍbhir yāgasāraṃ puṣpādi ca prokṣayet

plain_english: Then in the halo-circle, on ground or in sky: oṃ to the outer retinue, hail — thus one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ prabhāmaṇḍale bhūmau khe vā oṃ bāhyaparivārāya nama iti pūjayet

plain_english: Then at the door-place: oṃ to the door-deity-wheel, hail — thus one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: tato dvārasthāne oṃ dvāradevatācakrāya nama iti pūjayet

plain_english: But when there is an unguarded outer place, having entered, on the maṇḍala-altar-front alone one should do the outer-retinue-door-deity-wheel worship, the aforesaid placing and the rest — not outside.
sanskrit_cite: agupte tu bahiḥsthāne sati praviśya maṇḍalasthaṇḍilāgra eva bāhyaparivāradvāradevatācakrapūjāṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca nyāsādi kuryāt na bahiḥ

plain_english: Then too: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ — thus, having thrown the weapon-muttered flower, having removed the obstacles, having meditated, having entered within, with gaze kindled by the Lord's ray, one should see all around the worship-house.
sanskrit_cite: tato 'pi phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ iti astrajaptapuṣpaṃ prakṣipya vighnān apasāritān dhyātvā antaḥ praviśya parameśvarakiraṇeddhayā dṛṣṭyā abhito yāgagṛhaṃ paśyet

plain_english: There the release-seeker should stand facing north, so that by the Lord's Aghora-radiance swiftly indeed, his bonds burnt, he may become.
sanskrit_cite: tatra mumukṣur uttarābhimukhas tiṣṭhet yathā bhagavadaghoratejasā jhaṭity eva pruṣṭapāśo bhavet

plain_english: There the Lord's freedom alone, by form-shining, shines forth the direction-principle.
sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvarasvātantryam eva mūrtyābhāsanayā diktattvam avabhāsayati

plain_english: There awareness-light alone is the middle; thence, other-division arising: what is taken as light is above, what is not thus is below; what faces the light is east, the other is west; from having become facing-light, the next is that-light-stream-rise-place; south from favour, facing it, but from to-be-shone, north — thus the direction-four.
sanskrit_cite: tatra citprakāśa eva madhyaṃ tata itarapravibhāgapravṛtteḥ prakāśasvīkāryam ūrdhvam atathābhūtam adhaḥ prakāśanasammukhīnaṃ pūrvam itarat aparam saṃmukhībhūtaprakāśatvāt anantaraṃ tatprakāśadhārārohasthānaṃ dakṣiṇam ānukūlyāt tatsammukhaṃ tu avabhāsyatvāt uttaram iti dikcatuṣkam

plain_english: There in the middle the Lord; above, his is the north-eastern face; below, the underworld face; in the east-and-rest four directions, the so-called Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, Sadyas, Vāma; in the four-direction-middle, the other four.
sanskrit_cite: tatra madhye bhagavān ūrdhve 'sya aiśānaṃ vaktram adhaḥ pātālavaktram pūrvādidikcatuṣke śrītatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmākhyaṃ dikcatuṣkamadhye anyāś catasraḥ

plain_english: Thus indeed awareness-glory alone, formed, shines forth direction-difference — thus direction is not another principle.
sanskrit_cite: ity evaṃ saṃvinmahimaiva mūrtikṛtaṃ digbhedaṃ bhāsayati iti dik na tattvāntaram

plain_english: As, as the shadow is to be overstepped — being, before, before, it becomes — so reaching the Lord's centrality: being all-presiding alone is centrality — thus it is said.
sanskrit_cite: yathā yathā ca svacchāyā laṅghayitum iṣṭā satī puraḥ puro bhavati tathā parameśvaramadhyatām eti sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtaiva mādhyasthyam ity uktam

plain_english: Thus as the Lord is the divider of directions, so the sun — for it indeed is the Lord's knowledge-power, thus said: there, there, there the east is of the manifest from the east; and just where, so there — thus self-ruled even, facing one's own place, is in front.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yathā bhagavān digvibhāgakārī tathā sūryo 'pi sa hi pārameśvary eva jñānaśaktir ity uktaṃ tatra tatra tatra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ pūrvā yatraiva ca tathā tatraiva evaṃ svātmādhīnāpi svasammukhīnasya deśasya purastāttvāt

plain_english: Thus by self-sun-Lord-triad-unification is direction-discussion — thus Abhinavagupta's gurus.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svātmasūryaparameśatritayaikībhāvanayā dikcarcā iti abhinavaguptaguravaḥ

plain_english: Thus standing, facing north one should sit, burning body-ness in body-city-eight and the rest by I-feeling abandonment; from nearness as another's body, from bodilessness — then mounted on the waveless steady abode, from gaze-nature — which indeed is the first throb-digit — that alone is the form; thereupon is the as-taught worshippable-deity-wheel-placing; chiefly too here the powers are to be worshipped.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sthite uttarābhimukham upaviśya dehapuryaṣṭakādau ahambhāvatyāgena dehatāṃ dahet saṃnidhāv api paradehavat adehatvāt tato nistaraṅgadhruvadhāmarūḍhasya dṛṣṭisvābhāvyāt yā kila ādyā spandakalā saiva mūrtiḥ tadupari yathopadiṣṭayājyadevatācakranyāsaḥ prādhānyena ca iha śaktayo yājyāḥ

plain_english: From being that seat, of the Lord-nine-self and the rest, of power alone and of worship-worthiness — thus the gurus.
sanskrit_cite: tadāsanatvāt bhagavannavātmādīnāṃ śakter eva ca pūjyatvāt iti guravaḥ

plain_english: There five states: waking and the rest; and sixth called unsurpassed, nature-state to be contemplated.
sanskrit_cite: tatra ca pañca avasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca anuttarā nāma svabhāvadaśā anusaṃdheyā

plain_english: Thus sixfold is the placing.
sanskrit_cite: iti ṣoḍhā nyāso bhavati

plain_english: There from the presiding of causes, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-power-formed, each from thirty-six-principle-group, world-transcended in Bhairava-Lord-non-difference-course placing, from fullness is Bhairavī-being; hence this has no opening.
sanskrit_cite: tatra kāraṇānāṃ brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivaśaktirūpāṇāṃ pratyekam adhiṣṭhānāt ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakalāpasya laukikatattvottīrṇasya bhairavabhaṭṭārakābhedavṛtte nyāse pūrṇatvāt bhairavībhāvaḥ tena etat anavakāśam

plain_english: Which, they said: gained in waveless mounting, again what with principle-emission through placing and the rest — thus.
sanskrit_cite: yad āhuḥ ataraṅgarūḍhau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ kiṃ tattvasṛṣṭir nyāsādinā iti

plain_english: So long indeed that waveless Bhairava-formed, which in own self shows emission-dissolution-variety-peak.
sanskrit_cite: tāvat hi tad ataraṅgaṃ bhairavavapuḥ yat svātmani avabhāsitasṛṣṭisaṃhārāvaicitryakoṭi

plain_english: Thus by mutual-meeting-yoga, Lord-made breath-body-mind contemplated, outside and within with flowers-smoke-satings as possible, one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: evam anyonyamelakayogena parameśvarībhūtaṃ prāṇadehabuddhyādi bhāvayitvā bahir antaḥ puṣpadhūpatarpaṇādyair yathāsambhavaṃ pūjayet

plain_english: There in the body, in breath, in mind accordingly one should do the trident-lotus-placing — as at base-power-root: root, bulb, to-root-pith, at the hanging-end, to kalā-principle's end the staff; Māyā-natured knot; four-natured pure-knowledge lotus; right there the Lord Sadāśiva; he alone the great corpse; through excellence dissolved, from awakening, chiefly, from knowable-bodied body-decay, and from sound-touch-awareness-nature.
sanskrit_cite: tatra śarīre prāṇe dhiyi ca tadanusāreṇa śūlābjanyāsaṃ kuryāt tad yathā ādhāraśaktimūle mūlaṃ kanda āmūlasārakaṃ lambikānte kalātattvānto daṇḍaḥ māyātmako granthiḥ catuṣkikātmā śuddhavidyāpadmaṃ tatraiva sadāśivabhaṭṭārakaḥ sa eva mahāpretaḥ prakarṣeṇa līnatvāt bodhāt prādhānyena vedyātmakadehakṣayāt nādāmarśātmakatvāc ca iti

plain_english: That risen from the navel, come out of the three head-openings at its top, abiding inside sound, power-pervader, equanimity-formed and the rest, the six-end; thereupon is the pure lotus-triad, beyond-mind; on this universe-made division made seat, presiding as pervading-being, the desired become-supported deity having fashioned — which right there, in same-disposition-full self, universe-being-offering: that alone is worship; which alone becoming-that: that is meditation; which inner-deliberation-being-shaking as of such: that is murmur; which by such-deliberation-order-awakened great-splendour, by that force alone, is universe-self-making: that is oblation; that very thing done thus, the retinue, from that alone, like sparks from a fire-heap, having meditated, just so one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: tan nābhyutthitaṃ tanmūrdharandhratrayanirgataṃ nādāntarvartiśaktivyāpinīsamanārūpamarātrayaṃ dviṣaṭkāntaṃ tadupari śuddhapadmatrayam aunmanasam etasmin viśvamaye bhede āsanīkṛte adhiṣṭhātṛtayā vyāpakabhāvena ādheyabhūtāṃ yathābhimatāṃ devatāṃ kalpayitvā yat tatraiva samasvabhāvanirbharātmani viśvabhāvārpaṇaṃ tad eva pūjanaṃ yad eva tanmayībhavanaṃ tad dhyānaṃ yat tathāvidhāntaḥparāmarśasadbhāvanādāndolanaṃ sa japaḥ yat tathāvidhaparāmarśakramaprabuddhamahātejasā tathābalād eva viśvātmīkaraṇaṃ sa homaḥ tad evaṃ kṛtvā parivāraṃ tata eva vahnirāśer visphuliṅgavat dhyātvā tathaiva pūjayet

plain_english: Remembering the twelve-end, this foremost trident, from the root.
sanskrit_cite: dvādaśāntam idaṃ prāgraṃ viśūlaṃ mūlataḥ smaran

plain_english: Leaving sequence, going to goddess-wheel-front attains sky-going-ness.
sanskrit_cite: devīcakrāgragaṃ tyaktakramaḥ khecaratāṃ vrajet

plain_english: From root-support, of twice-six-end-sky-peak-filling nature.
sanskrit_cite: mūlādhārād dviṣaṭkāntavyomāgrāpūraṇātmikā

plain_english: Of sky-going-ness, from sky-faring-rest and from sky-nectar-eating.
sanskrit_cite: khecarīyaṃ khasaṃcāramsthitibhyāṃ khāmṛtāśanāt

plain_english: Thus by inner rite alone, in reality, done-what-was-to-be-done.
sanskrit_cite: evam antaryāgamātrād eva vastutaḥ kṛtakṛtyatā

plain_english: Truly for the then-entered, still outer is to be done, to remove limitation alone — and who too thus does not partake immersion: his chief is the outer rite; from its practice, immersion-gain; since for him too, but the beast-veiling inner rite, when mounted on that too, of his thought-force is purity-giving.
sanskrit_cite: satyataḥ tadāviṣṭasya tathāpi bahir api kāryo yāgo 'vacchedahānaya eva yo 'pi tathā samāveśabhāk na bhavati tasya mukhyo bahiryāgaḥ tadabhyāsāt samāveśalābho yatas tasyāpi tu paśutātirodhānāyāntaryāgaḥ tadarūḍhāv api tatsaṃkalpabalasya śuddhipradatvāt

plain_english: Now when one wishes to do initiation, then for preparation: ground-taking, Gaṇeśa-worship, jar-and-vessel worship, altar-worship, oblation — one should do.
sanskrit_cite: atha yadā dīkṣāṃ cikīrṣet tadādhivāsanārthaṃ bhūmiparigrahaṃ gaṇeśārcanaṃ kumbhakalaśayoḥ pūjāṃ sthaṇḍilārcanaṃ havanaṃ ca kuryāt

plain_english: But in daily-and-occasional: altar-and-rest worship-oblation alone.
sanskrit_cite: nityanaimittikayos tu sthaṇḍilādyarcanahavane eva

plain_english: There is initiation-preparation, the disciple's refined-fitness-placing, like sharpening of teeth; the God's toward-work-upturned-ness-grasping, the guru's taking of that.
sanskrit_cite: tatra adhivāsanaṃ śiṣyasya saṃskṛtayogyatādhānam amblīkaraṇam iva dantānāṃ devasya kartavyonmukhatvagrāhaṇam guros tadgrahaṇam

plain_english: Of implement-things, by being inside the worship-house, through the Lord's radiance-swelling, is bestowing of worship-implement-fitness — thus.
sanskrit_cite: upakaraṇadravyāṇāṃ yāgagṛhāntarvartitayā parameśatejobṛṃhaṇena pūjopakaraṇayogyatārpaṇam iti

plain_english: There, having arranged the worship-house full of all implements, having remembered the Goddess Mālinī or Mātṛkā, bearing the taken, full of her-letter-radiance-mass, one should cast the flower-handful.
sanskrit_cite: tatra sarvopakaraṇapūrṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vidhāya bhagavatīṃ mālinīṃ mātṛkāṃ vā smṛtvā tadvarṇatejaḥpuñjabharitaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhāvayan puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet

plain_english: Then the stated weapon-muttered mustard-grain-parched-rice and the rest, radiance-formed, having scattered, in the north-east direction gathering in order — thus is ground-taking.
sanskrit_cite: tata uktāstrajaptāni yathāsambhavaṃ siddhārthadhānyākṣatalājādīni tejorūpāṇi vikīrya aiśānyāṃ diśi krameṇa saṃghaṭṭayet iti bhūparigrahaḥ

plain_english: Then having given the seat up to pure-knowledge's end, Gaṇeśa's worship; then having filled the jar, filled with bliss-substance, adorned, one should worship; then the worshippable next, having placed betel, there the chief mantra, as all-presiding, remembering with rule-precedence, with that 108-times-muttered, that jar one should make.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śuddhavidyāntam āsanaṃ dattvā gaṇapateḥ pūjā tataḥ kumbham ānandadravyapūritam alaṃkṛtaṃ pūjayet tato yājyam anu pūgaṃ nyasya tatra mukhyaṃ mantraṃ sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtayā vidhipūrvakatvena smaran aṣṭottaraśatamantritaṃ tena taṃ kumbhaṃ kuryāt

plain_english: In the second vessel, weapons for obstacle-quelling one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: dvitīyakalaśe vighnaśamanāya astraṃ yajet

plain_english: Then in own directions the world-guardians with weapons one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svasvadikṣu lokapālān sāstrān pūjayet

plain_english: Then to the previously-initiated disciple's hand one should give the weapon-vessel.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śiṣyasya prāk dīkṣitasya haste astrakalaśaṃ dadyāt

plain_english: And oneself the guru should take the jar.
sanskrit_cite: svayaṃ ca guruḥ kumbham ādadīta

plain_english: Then making the disciple pour the stream around the house for obstacle-quelling, with jar the guru should follow, reciting this mantra: O O Indra! by you in your own direction for obstacle-pacifying.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śiṣyaṃ gṛhaparyanteṣu vighnaśamanāya dhārāṃ pātayantaṃ sakumbho 'nugacchet imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye

plain_english: With attentiveness, to be done to rite's end, by Śiva's command.
sanskrit_cite: sāvadhānena karmāntaṃ bhavitavyaṃ śivājñayā

plain_english: In the three-syllabled name, 'bho' is one alone — thus.
sanskrit_cite: tryakṣare nāmni bho ity ekam eva

plain_english: Then in the north-east direction one should place the jar.
sanskrit_cite: tata aiśānyāṃ diśi kumbhaṃ sthāpayet

plain_english: Upon the scattered, the weapon-vessel.
sanskrit_cite: vikiropari astrakalaśam

plain_english: Then worship of both.
sanskrit_cite: tata ubhayapūjanam

plain_english: Then in the altar-middle Supreme-worship.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sthaṇḍilamadhye parameśapūjanam

plain_english: Then the fire-pit as Supreme-power-formed having contemplated, fire having kindled there, with heart-inner-awakening-fire made one, with mantra-deliberation-accompaniment, the blazing Śiva-fire having contemplated, placed there, having worshipped, one should sate the mantras with ghee and sesame.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ agnikuṇḍaṃ parameśvaraśaktirūpatayā bhāvayitvā tatra agniṃ prajvālya hṛdayāntarbodhāgninā saha ekīkṛtya mantraparāmarśasāhityena jvalantaṃ śivāgniṃ bhāvayitvā tatra nyasya abhyarcya mantrān tarpayet ājyena tilaiś ca

plain_english: And with the vessel, sprinkling alone is sesame-ghee and the rest's refining.
sanskrit_cite: arghapātreṇa ca prokṣaṇam eva tilājyādīnāṃ saṃskāraḥ

plain_english: And of ladle-and-spoon, non-difference-view alone indeed is refining.
sanskrit_cite: sruksruvayoś ca parameśābhedadṛṣṭir eva hi saṃskāraḥ

plain_english: Then having offered as able, having arranged ladle-spoon up-down-facing as power-Śiva-formed, mutually facing, having stood even-footed, contemplating the stream of supreme nectar fallen, risen in the sky of the twelve-end, risen full-Śiva-moon, and uttering the vauṣaḍ-ending mantra, until ghee's end one should stand — thus is full oblation, mantra-wheel-sating.
sanskrit_cite: tato yathāśakti hutvā sruksruvau ūrdhvādhomukhatayā śaktiśivarūpau parasparonmukhau vidhāya samapādotthito dvādaśāntagaganoditaśivapūrṇacandraniḥsṛtapatatparāmṛtadhārābhāvanāṃ kurvan vauṣaḍantaṃ mantram uccārayan ca ājyakṣayāntaṃ tiṣṭhet iti pūrṇāhutiḥ mantracakrasaṃtarpaṇī

plain_english: Then the sprinkled caru having brought, on altar-vessel-jar-fires share by share having offered, one share having left over, to the disciple one should give a share.
sanskrit_cite: tataś caruṃ prokṣitam ānīya sthaṇḍilakalaśakumbhavahniṣu bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nivedya ekabhāgam avaśeṣya śiṣyāya bhāgaṃ dadyāt

plain_english: Then the tooth-stick.
sanskrit_cite: tato dantakāṣṭham

plain_english: Its falling in fire-Yama-Nirṛti directions and below is not auspicious — thus.
sanskrit_cite: tatpāto 'gniyamanirṛtidikṣu adhaś ca na śubha iti

plain_english: There oblation by weapon-mantra is to be done.
sanskrit_cite: tatra homo 'stramantreṇa kāryaḥ

plain_english: Then for distraction-avoidance, for fitness to see the future mantra, having brought in the blindfolded disciple, having made him kneeling, one should have him cast a flower-handful.
sanskrit_cite: tato vikṣepaparihāreṇa bhāvimantradarśanayogyatāyai baddhanetraṃ śiṣyaṃ praveśya jānusthitaṃ taṃ kṛtvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣepayet

plain_english: Then suddenly, unfastened-eye-bound, through descent-graced instrument-ness, seeing the present mantra in that place face-to-face, he becomes made of that; of graced instruments mantra-nearness is visible, since as it were of trembling beings.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sahasā apāsitanetrabandho 'sau śaktipātānugṛhītakaraṇatvāt saṃnihitamantraṃ tatsthānaṃ sākṣātkāreṇa paśyan tanmayo bhavati anugṛhītakaraṇānāṃ mantrasaṃnidhiḥ pratyakṣaḥ yatas trasyatām iva bhūtānām

plain_english: Then in one's own right hand with blazing, having worshipped the deity-wheel, placing it burning the disciple's bonds on head-heart-navel.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svadakṣiṇahaste dīpyatayā devatācakraṃ pūjayitvā taṃ hastaṃ mūrdhahṛnnābhiṣu śiṣyasya pāśān dahantaṃ nikṣipet

plain_english: Then in the left with gentleness, having worshipped, fattening with pure principle — then one should bow.
sanskrit_cite: tato vāme somyatayā pūjayitvā śuddhatattvāpyāyinaṃ tataḥ praṇāmaṃ kuryāt

plain_english: Then the being-deity-direction-offering, full of wine-meat-water and the rest, outside one should give, having sipped.
sanskrit_cite: tato bhūtadevatādigbaliṃ madyamāṃsajalādipūrṇaṃ bahir dadyāt ācāmeta

plain_english: Then oneself having eaten the oblation-meal, with disciple-self attaining oneness, awakened-natured one should stay.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svayaṃ carubhojanaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmanā saha aikyam āpannaḥ prabuddhavṛttiḥ tiṣṭhet

plain_english: Dreaming too, at dawn if the disciple tells an inauspicious dream — that to him one should not explain.
sanskrit_cite: svapan api prabhāte śiṣyaḥ cet aśubhaṃ svapnaṃ vadet tat asmai na vyākuryāt

plain_english: For doubt and fear would be his; merely with the weapon one should make its expiation.
sanskrit_cite: śaṅkātaṅkau hi tathāsya syātām kevalam astreṇa tanniṣkṛtiṃ kuryāt

plain_english: Then just so having worshipped the Lord, entered before him by the disciple's breath-course, touching the six-cause-touching in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends, each eight refinements contemplating, some time resting the disciple-breath right there, again one should descend.
sanskrit_cite: tatas tathaiva parameśvaraṃ pūjayitvā tadagre śiṣyasya prāṇakrameṇa praviśya hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu ṣaṭsu kāraṇaṣaṭkasparśaṃ kurvan pratyekam aṣṭau saṃskārān cintayan kaṃcit kālaṃ śiṣyaprāṇaṃ tatraiva viśramayya punar avarohet

plain_english: Thus effected-forty-eight-refinements-upon-made-Rudra-part-attainment becomes a samayin.
sanskrit_cite: ity evāpāditāṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃskāroparikṛtarudrāṃśāpattiḥ samayībhavati

plain_english: Then to him the worshippable mantra with flowers and the rest one should bestow.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ asmai pūjyaṃ mantraṃ puṣpādyaiḥ saha arpayet

plain_english: Then the rules to him one should lay down.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ samayān asmai nirūpayet

plain_english: In the guru with whole self, devotion; so in scripture; in God; aversion toward their opponents; like the guru, of the guru's son and the rest; of the knowledge-tied made, of the before-initiated and the rest, seeing; of the womb-tie, for its honouring, not by oneself — thus to be deemed.
sanskrit_cite: gurau sarvātmanā bhaktiḥ tathā śāstre deve tatpratidvaṃdvini parāṅmukhatā guruvat guruputrādeḥ vidyāsambandhakṛtasya tatpūrvadīkṣitādeḥ saṃdarśanam yaunasambandhasya tadārādhanārtham na tu svata iti mantavyam

plain_english: Of women, of the barren that-loathing-cause one should not do.
sanskrit_cite: striyo vandhyāyās tajjugupsāhetuṃ na kuryāt

plain_english: Deity-name, guru-name, and mantra, apart from worship-time one should not utter.
sanskrit_cite: devatānāma gurunāma tathā mantraṃ pūjākālāt ṛte na uccārayet

plain_english: What the guru has enjoyed — bed and the rest — one should not enjoy.
sanskrit_cite: gurūpabhuktaṃ śayyādi na bhuñjīta

plain_english: What games and the rest are worldly, that in the guru's nearness one should not do.
sanskrit_cite: yat kiṃcit laukikaṃ krīḍādi tat gurusaṃnidhau na kuryāt

plain_english: Apart from that, elsewhere one should not make excellence-thought.
sanskrit_cite: tadvyatirekeṇa na anyatra utkarṣabuddhiṃ kuryāt

plain_english: Everywhere, in śrāddha and the rest, the guru alone one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: sarvatra śrāddhādau gurum eva pūjayet

plain_english: And in all occasionals, śākinī-and-the-rest words one should not say.
sanskrit_cite: sarveṣu ca naimittikeṣu śākinītyādiśabdān na vadet

plain_english: Festival days one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: parvadināni pūjayet

plain_english: With those of lower sight, Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, company one should not make.
sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādyair adhodṛṣṭibhiḥ saha saṃgatiṃ na kuryāt

plain_english: Abiding in this teaching, one should not see with former-birth thought.
sanskrit_cite: etacchāsanasthān pūrvajātibuddhyā na paśyet

plain_english: When the guru's circle has come home, as able one should do worship.
sanskrit_cite: guruvarge gṛhāgate yathāśakti yāgaṃ kuryāt

plain_english: A lower-path abider, a Vaiṣṇava and the rest, having even made him guru, from his teaching-clan one should abandon.
sanskrit_cite: adhomārgasthitaṃ kaṃcit vaiṣṇavādyaṃ tacchāstrakulāt gurūkṛtyāpi tyajet

plain_english: Even then one should not see with excellence-thought.
sanskrit_cite: tadāpi na utkarṣabuddhyā paśyet

plain_english: With mark-bearers no conduct-meeting one should make; them only as able one should worship.
sanskrit_cite: liṅgibhiḥ saha samācāramelanaṃ na kuryāt tān kevalaṃ yathāśakti pūjayet

plain_english: Doubts one should abandon.
sanskrit_cite: śaṅkās tyajet

plain_english: In the wheel, standing, of last-and-first division, birth-made, one should not fancy.
sanskrit_cite: cakre sthitaś caramāgryādivibhāgaṃ janmakṛtaṃ na saṃkalpayet

plain_english: Apart from the body, no other abode-ford and the rest with high regard one should see.
sanskrit_cite: śarīrāt ṛte na anyat āyatanatīrthādikaṃ bahumānena paśyet

plain_english: Constantly one should remember the mantra-heart — thus the disciple, having heard, having bowed, having accepted, the guru with wealth-wife-body-up-to gift pleasing, and the before-initiated and poor-lordless and the rest sating.
sanskrit_cite: mantrahṛdayam anavarataṃ smaret ity evaṃ śiṣyaḥ śrutvā praṇamya abhyupagamya guruṃ dhanadāraśarīraparyantayā dakṣiṇayā paritoṣya pūrvadīkṣitāṃś ca dīnānāthādikān tarpayet

plain_english: And with the future rule, the image-wheel one should sate.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvividhinā ca mūrticakraṃ tarpayet

plain_english: Thus one becomes a samayin.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ samayībhavati

plain_english: In mantra-practice, daily worship, hearing, study, one is entitled; but in the occasional, everywhere the guru alone one should request.
sanskrit_cite: mantrābhyāse nityapūjāyāṃ śravaṇe 'dhyayane adhikārī naimittike tu sarvatra gurum eva abhyarthayet

plain_english: Thus the samayin rule.
sanskrit_cite: iti sāmayiko vidhiḥ
